verses: Aey nabi! jiss cheez ko Allah ney aap kay liye halal ker diya hai ussay aap kiyon haram kertay hain? (kiya) aap apni biwiyon ki razamandi hasil kerna chahatay hain aur Allah bakhshney wala reham kerney wala hai
Tehqeeq kay Allah Taalaa ney tumharay liye qasmon ko khol daalna muqarrar ker diya hai aur Allah tumhara kaarsaaz hai aur o hi (pooray) ilm wala, hikmat wala hai

Aur yaad ker jab nabi ney apni baaz aurton say aik posheedah baat kahi, pus jab uss ney uss baat ki khabar ker di aur Allah ney apney nabi ko uss per aagah ker diya to nabi ney thori si baat to bata di aur thori si taal gaye, phir jab nabi ney apni uss biwi ko yeh baat bataee to woh kehney lagi uss ki khabar aap ko kiss ney di. Kaha sab jannay walay poori khabar rakhney walay Allah ney mujhay yeh batlaya hai

(aey nabi ki dono biwiyo!) agar tum dono Allah kay samney tauba kerlo (to boht behtar hai) yaqeenan tumharay dil jhuk paray hain aur agar tum nabi kay khilaf aik doosray ki madad kero gi pus yaqeenan uss ka kaarsaaz Allah hai aur jibraeel hain aur nek ahl eman aur unn kay alawa farishtay bhi madad kerney walay hain

Agar woh (payghumbar) tumhen tallaq dey den to boht jald unhen unn ka rab! tumharay badlay tum say behtar biwiyan inayat farmaye ga, jo islam waliyan, eman waliyan Allah kay huzoor jhukney waliyan tauba kerney waliyan, ibadat baja laney waliyan rozay rakhney waliyan hun gi bibi woh aur kanwariyan

Aey eman walo! tum apney aap ko aur apney ghar walon ko uss aag say bachao jiss ka endhan insan hain aur pathar jiss per sakht dil mazboot farishtay muqarrar hain jinhen jo hukum Allah Taalaa deta hai uss ki na-farmani nahi kertay balkay)yeh jo hukum diya jaye baja latay hain
Aey kafiro! aaj tum uzur o bahana mat kero. Tumhen sirf tumharay kartoot ka badla diya jaraha hai.

Aey eman walo! tum Allah kay samney sachi khalis tauba kero. Qareeb hai kay tumhara rab tumharay gunah door ker dey aur tumhen aisi jannaton mein dakhil keray jin kay neechay nehren jari hain. Jiss din Allah Taalaa nabi ko aur eman walon ko jo unn kay sath hain ruswa na keray ga. Unn ka noor unn kay samney aur unn kay dayen dor raha hoga. Yeh duayen kertay hun gay aey humaray rab humen kamil noor ata farma aur humen bakhsh dey yaqeenan to her cheez per qadir hai
Aey nabi! kafiron aur munafiqon say jihad kero aur unn per sakhti kero unn ka thikana jahannum hai aur woh boht buri jagah hai

Allah Taalaa ney kafiron kay liye Nooh ki aur Loot ki biwi ki misal biyan farmaee yeh dono humaray bandon mein say do (shaista aur) nek bandon kay ghar mein thin, phir unn ki unhon ney khayanat ki pus woh dono (nek banday) unn say Allah kay (kissi azab ko) na rok sakay aur hukum dey diya gaya (aey aurton) dozakh mein janey walon kay sath tum dono bhi chali jao

Aur Allah Taalaa ney eman walon kay liye Firaun ki biwi ki misal biyan farmaee jabkay uss ney dua ki kay aey meray rab! meray liye apney pass jannat mein makan bana aur mujhay Firaun say aur uss kay amal say bacha aur mujhay zalim logon say khulasi dey

Aur (misal biyan farmaee) Maryam bint imran ki jiss ney apney namoos ki hifazat ki phir hum ney apni taraf say uss mein jaan phoonk di aur (Maryam) uss ney apney rab ki baaton aur uss ki kitabon ki tasdeeq ki aur ibadat guzaron mein say thi
